subject.title: fix(qa): label static scorecard data as inventory

question: Should the shipped static QA scorecard JSON fields and validation codes be renamed in place, or should this terminology correction use a versioned/additive transition?
rationale: The semantic correction is sound, but repository history shows this machine-readable scorecard surface has shipped, and the patch intentionally provides no compatibility alias or version boundary.

options.title: Version the report shape
options.body: Introduce an explicit version or additive transition so existing QA automation can migrate without abruptly losing the old field and diagnostic names.

options.title: Accept the in-place rename
options.body: Merge the current patch only if the owner confirms that the static scorecard JSON and diagnostic strings are internal, unconsumed, and not a supported compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Version the report shape
recommendation.body: Introduce an explicit version or additive transition so existing QA automation can migrate without abruptly losing the old field and diagnostic names.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa introduced and recently maintained the scorecard taxonomy and evidence-reporting surfaces affected by this compatibility choice.
